tagline: The old scenic route to Duluth, over the trout streams.
intro: From the Banning exit on I-35, Highway 23 heads north and east for 50 miles through Askov, Bruno, Kerrick, Duquette, Nickerson and Wrenshall, and for decades people have called it the scenic route to Duluth. Creeks and small rivers cross it all the way up, and on the northern stretch the Nemadji and the South Fork are known for their trout.
Near the end of the route the Veterans Memorial Overlook looks out over the St. Louis River valley.

moments.title: Banning State Park
moments.text: The Kettle River churns through a mile and a half of rapids here, Hell's Gate among them, past an old sandstone quarry whose town, the reason the park was made, has vanished entirely.

moments.title: Biauswah Bridge
moments.text: In Duluth's Fond du Lac neighborhood the highway crosses the St. Louis River on a bridge dedicated in 2008 to American Indian veterans.
